meta_title: Mythaia — a proxy client for filtered networks
meta_description: Mythaia is a free, open-source proxy client for Android and Windows: VLESS with Reality, Hysteria2, TUIC, Trojan, Shadowsocks and WireGuard, with domain fronting and automatic server selection.
hero_lead: A proxy client with its own protocol stack, built for networks that filter hard. Free and open source — no ads, no trackers, no account.
features_title: Built for networks that filter hard
features_lead: One Kotlin core runs both apps, so a link, a subscription or a fix behaves the same on the phone and on the PC.
f1_text: VLESS with Vision, Reality and XHTTP, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks 2022, Hysteria2 with Salamander, TUIC v5, AnyTLS, NaiveProxy, WireGuard and SOCKS5.
f2_text: Protocols, TLS and routing are written in Kotlin from the ground up. No Xray-core or sing-box inside, no Go runtime — a small app.
f3_text: When a panel's domain is blocked, Mythaia downloads the subscription through a CDN that is not — and the fronting can travel inside the link itself.
f4_text: Picks the fastest server of a group, keeps measuring and moves only for a clear gain. Reconnects on its own when a server is blocked.
f5_text: Rule and global modes, rule sets by domain, IP and GeoIP, per-app split tunnelling, ad blocking, DNS over HTTPS and TLS. Local sites can go direct.
f6_text: Ping over TCP or, for QUIC servers, UDP. Remove the servers that fail, export a group as links. Tested with 10,000 servers.
f7_text: System proxy, or the whole computer through Wintun. With the Mythaia service, TUN starts without an administrator prompt.
f8_text: No ads, no analytics, no account. The code is open under GPL-3.0, Android builds are signed with one release key, and every file is checksummed.
fronting_text: A panel whose domain is blocked can often still be reached through a CDN that is not. Mythaia connects to the front, sends an innocent name in the TLS handshake and the panel's real one in the HTTP Host header. Put the front in the link, and whoever you share it with adds the subscription in one step.
fronting_note: The part after # never reaches the panel, so the same link still works in other clients. A mythaia://import link opens the app straight from a browser or a messenger.

verify_title: Make sure it is the real one
verify_text: Download only from GitHub or our Telegram channel. A new version installs over the old one; if Android says the app was not installed or conflicts with an existing package, the file was signed with another key — do not install it.
verify_sums: Every release carries SHA256SUMS.txt. Check a download with sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt.

a1: No. Mythaia is a client: it connects to servers you already have — your own, or a provider's subscription. It does not sell servers.
a2: Yes. Free and open source under GPL-3.0, with no ads and no paid tier.
a3: No. Mythaia runs no servers of its own: there is no analytics, no ad SDK and no account. Latency and connectivity checks go through your own servers.
q4: Which Android file do I need?
a4: The universal APK works on every device. The arm64 one is smaller and fits most phones of recent years.
q5: Windows says it protected my PC.
a5: The Windows builds are not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen does not know them. Check the file against SHA256SUMS.txt, then choose More info → Run anyway.
a6: Install the new version over the old one; servers and settings stay. On Windows with the Mythaia service, press Update next to it in the settings afterwards.
